capabilities: Assign icons and colors to files, folders, tab headers, bookmarks and ribbon actions
Install icon packs from the Iconify catalogue or from npm packages with SVG files
Browse and organize a built-in icon library of Lucide icons and your own SVGs
Expose a cross-plugin API so other plugins can use the registered icons
extras: Notes a breaking v1.0 upgrade: the old 0.x CSS-snippet configuration is not migrated and the auto-generated CustomIcon-AutoGen snippet should be deleted from the vault. Beta versions are available via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Give plugins that ship without an icon one (a fix for Obsidian 1.11+)
problem: Obsidian gives little control over the icons shown across the workspace, and plugins that ship without icons look blank or generic.

relations.evidence: Inline Icons is a reference consumer: it renders icons inside note bodies using this registry.

summary: Icon manager that assigns icons and colors to files, folders, tab headers, bookmarks, ribbon actions and other plugins, backed by a built-in icon library.
